lines.text: In Zedekiah's tenth year, Babylon's army besieged Jerusalem while Jeremiah was imprisoned in the courtyard of the guard.
Zedekiah imprisoned Jeremiah for prophesying that Jerusalem would fall and that Zedekiah would be taken to Egypt.
As the LORD had said, Jeremiah's cousin Hanamel came and urged him to buy his field in Anathoth.
Jeremiah bought Hanamel's field for seventeen shekels of silver, signed and sealed the deed, and called in witnesses.
Jeremiah gave the deed to Gedaliah and told him to put both copies in a clay jar.
